title: A Low-Latency Web Telemetry Control Interface for 12-DOF Quadruped Locomotion
authors: Shourov Paul, M. R. H. Mojumder, and Taher Hasan Nakib
abstract: This paper presents a complete software and hardware framework for a 12-DOF quadruped robot. We detail a 3-DOF inverse kinematics solver running on an embedded microcontroller and a Web Serial-based telemetry dashboard. The system achieves sub-10ms response times for real-time state visualization and parameter tuning.

title: Power-Optimized Cellular IoT Telemetry: A SIM800L and Raspberry Pi Pico Integration Study
authors: Shourov Paul, and Md. Rayid Hasan Mojumder
abstract: Integrating Neo-6M GPS modules and SIM800L transceivers with low-power microcontrollers poses critical power management challenges. We present dynamic sleep states and network handshake optimization algorithms that improve overall battery life by 35% during continuous cellular network tracking.

title: Design of a Pure Sine Wave Inverter with Real-Time Feedback and Microcontroller Control
authors: Shourov Paul, Seongchan Kim, and Cunjiang Yu
abstract: This work demonstrates the design and deployment of a pure sine wave power inverter using sinusoidal pulse-width modulation (SPWM) on a PIC microcontroller. We describe a digital feedback control loop that actively adjusts PWM cycles to maintain total harmonic distortion (THD) under 3% across static and dynamic loads.
